programs.title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
programs.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi ask the eight remaining chefs to battle in teams of four, and the winning team gets some well-deserved rest. The losing team must make their best late-night eats for judges Brooke Williamson and Ayesha Nurdjaja.

programs.title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
programs.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi challenge the remaining six weary chefs to earn as many points as possible in a shift that's all about risk-taking; judge Marcel Vigneron decides their fate.

programs.title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
programs.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi give the remaining chefs a very limited time to execute two exacting dishes. Judge Andrew Zimmern decides which three chefs advance to the final shift, and the bottom two must battle each other.

programs.title: Chopped Castaways
programs.desc: The competition intensifies as the remaining 11 chefs must transform a mix of high-quality and low-quality ingredients into five family-style dishes under extreme island conditions.
